scheme_name: Training in Coir Component of the Development of Coir Scheme
other_conditions: Applicant must not have previously been trained under this scheme
Applicant must belong to the rural poor
benefits_summary: Trainees receive a stipend of ₹1,500 per month (₹9,000 total) and raw‑material wastage compensation; trainers receive an honorarium of ₹300 per month up to ₹3,000.
